_comment: Curated fields per VS Code extension -- displayName/pitch/niche/repo. Mirrors the shape of catalog_static_metadata.json but is a fully separate namespace (kept apart so the JetBrains-only parity checks in update-catalog.yml never see these entries). Live metrics (installs/rating/version/publishedDate) are NOT stored here -- pipeline/auto_update_vscode_catalog.py fetches those from the VS Code Marketplace public gallery API and merges them in at generation time.

android-unused-permission-companion.pitch: Flags a permission declared in AndroidManifest.xml that no Kotlin/Java source actually uses.

cargo-audit-companion.pitch: Wraps `cargo audit --json` as inline VS Code diagnostics on Cargo.toml -- RustSec advisories at the exact dependency line.

codeowners-validator-companion.pitch: Validates a CODEOWNERS file -- duplicated patterns, unmatched patterns, invalid owners, syntax errors.

config-secrets-file-companion.pitch: Flags a hardcoded secret (AWS key, GitHub/Slack token, JWT, PEM key, or high-entropy value) in config and env files.

dependency-license-companion.pitch: Reads each node_modules dependency's SPDX license locally and flags copyleft or missing licenses.

embedded-stack-usage-companion.pitch: Parses GCC .su stack-usage files (-fstack-usage) and flags any function over a configurable stack budget.

flaky-test-history-companion.pitch: Tracks pass/fail history per test across JUnit XML report runs and flags tests with mixed outcomes.

infoplist-usage-description-companion.pitch: Cross-checks Swift/Objective-C imports (CoreLocation, Contacts, Photos, etc.) against required Info.plist usage-description keys.

jwt-companion.pitch: Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens on hover or via command -- no data leaves your editor.

mlflow-companion.pitch: Browses local MLflow tracking-store runs (params, metrics, tags) in a sidebar tree, reading the store directly.

n-plus-one-query-companion.pitch: Flags a TypeORM/Sequelize/Drizzle find/query call inside a loop -- the classic N+1 query pattern.

node-version-drift-companion.pitch: Flags when .nvmrc/.node-version/package.json engines.node/Dockerfile/CI disagree on the Node.js version.

oauth2-oidc-flow-companion.pitch: Builds and decodes OAuth2 authorization-code+PKCE URLs -- generates code_verifier/challenge pairs and decodes callback params.

pact-contract-companion.pitch: Lists consumer-provider Pact contract files in your workspace and flags interactions with no matching provider state.

prometheus-alert-rule-companion.pitch: Lints Prometheus alert rule YAML -- duplicate alert names, missing 'for', missing annotations.

turborepo-graph-companion.pitch: Shows your Turborepo workspace dependency graph as a sidebar tree -- parses turbo.json + package.json workspaces.

typosquat-dependency-companion.pitch: Flags a package.json dependency whose name is a near-miss (edit distance 1-2) of a much more popular package.

unleash-flag-usage-companion.pitch: Inventories Unleash feature flag usage across your codebase -- naming check, find-all-usages, stale-flag detection.

unreal-uht-macro-companion.pitch: Flags common UnrealHeaderTool macro mistakes in C++ headers: missing .generated.h include and related UPROPERTY/UFUNCTION issues.

webhook-signature-companion.pitch: Computes and verifies HMAC webhook signatures (GitHub/generic sha1/sha256/sha512) against a payload and secret.

wrangler-config-companion.pitch: Validates wrangler.toml -- required fields (name/main/compatibility_date), and missing bindings.
